text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Birthday wishes from Prez! Cough! I choked!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's 'cause you're way too
happy. Guess
that means you're still a
kid at heart.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But come on, this is Prez we're talking
about! How
else am I supposed to react
when someone I
respect so much wishes
me happy birthday?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'm glad I said it then. But what if I
told you I
have a present for you as
well?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: A present from you?! Th-th-thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I asked around about your tastes and
settled on
mango tarts—hopefully
they're up to your
standards.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uwahhh! I LOVE mangoes! This is the
BEST
birthday ever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hnnghhh, I can't take this anymore! Why
do you
get to hog all the happy
memories?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? Uh, because it's my birthday?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I knooow! But you can't make me this
jealous and
not expect me to want some
attention too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your own birthday is but two weeks
away... Have
a little patience.
